Semantic Scholar

Free AI-powered academic search with paper summaries and citation graphs.

Key features of Semantic Scholar

  • Paper search
  • TLDR summaries
  • Citation graph
  • Alerts
  • API

Semantic Scholar pricing and rating

Pricing: Free. Plans change often, so check the official site for the latest details. Our editorial rating is 4.5 out of 5.
